name: woocommerce/product-terms-query
label: Query product terms
description: Find product categories, tags, brands or the terms of a global attribute, such as pa_color. Use include to retrieve specific term IDs.

taxonomy.description: Product taxonomy to query: product_cat, product_tag, product_brand, or the slug of a global attribute from product-attributes-query.

include.description: Limit results to these term IDs. Use one ID to retrieve a single term.

exclude.description: Exclude these term IDs. Ignored when include is set.

slug.description: Limit results to these slugs. Send one slug as a list of one. An empty list applies no slug filter.

parent.description: Parent term ID for categories or brands. Use zero for top-level terms.

product.description: Limit results to terms assigned to this product ID.

orderby.description: Defaults to name, or for a pa_* taxonomy to the order set on the attribute.

terms.description: Returned terms for the current page.

count.description: Number of published, catalog-visible products. hide_empty uses stored counts and also retains parents with non-empty children, so a returned term can have count zero.

total_pages.description: Total number of result pages available for the current query.

per_page.description: Maximum number of items requested per page.

total.description: Total number of matching terms across all pages.
